# Upstream Tool References

This page covers vendored upstream trees kept locally so they can be referenced quickly without leaving the workspace.

## graphql-eslint

- **What it is**: upstream GraphQL-ESLint monorepo.
- **Why it matters**: useful as a schema and GraphQL quality reference if this repo expands GraphQL surfaces.
- **Local sources**: `README.md`, `package.json`, `packages/`, `website/`

## inspector

- **What it is**: upstream MCP Inspector source tree.
- **Why it matters**: critical for local MCP development and debugging.
- **Local sources**: `README.md`, `package.json`, `cli/`, `server/`, `client/`

## magentic-main

- **What it is**: vendored Magentic source tree.
- **Why it matters**: reference material for agentic or LLM-driven orchestration patterns.

## mashumaro-master

- **What it is**: vendored serialization library source tree.
- **Why it matters**: useful Python reference if typed serialization becomes important in staging tools.

## snaparser_server-master

- **What it is**: Go server for Snapchat history parsing.
- **Why it matters**: directly relevant to social-export evidence parsing.
- **Local sources**: subtree README and Go sources

## sms-backup-and-restore-exporter-main

- **What it is**: Python exporter for SMS Backup & Restore archives.
- **Why it matters**: highly relevant to SMS evidence extraction and to the same input family as SBV.
- **Local sources**: subtree README and Python sources

## sms-log-convert-main

- **What it is**: SMS Backup & Restore XML to XLSX conversion utility.
- **Why it matters**: useful for analyst review or quick spreadsheet exports.
- **Local sources**: subtree README

## sextortion-investigation-toolkit-main

- **What it is**: domain-specific investigation toolkit source.
- **Why it matters**: relevant as a reference workflow set for coercion and abuse investigations.

## UWT5

- **What it is**: vendored upstream tree retained for later review.
- **Why it matters**: currently a reference asset only; needs deeper classification before promotion.

Sources: `tools/utilities/graphql-eslint/README.md`, `tools/utilities/inspector/README.md`, `tools/utilities/magentic-main`, `tools/utilities/mashumaro-master`, `tools/utilities/snaparser_server-master`, `tools/utilities/sms-backup-and-restore-exporter-main/README.md`, `tools/utilities/sms-log-convert-main/README.md`, `tools/utilities/sextortion-investigation-toolkit-main`, `tools/utilities/UWT5`
